    Given one consumed call of the run to rwb-case, rwb-access or rwb-decision is forced to fail or to give no answer within its 2 s budget
    When the run reaches that call
    Then the run stops at that hop and the report names the service, the operation and the contract version of the call
    Then no criterion of AC1 to AC6 is marked passed for a value that call would have answered
    Then the harness changes no state for the run
